name: Bordeaux
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: IGN’s official API Carto cadastre documentation describes open GeoJSON parcel geometry from official cadastral/Géoplateforme WFS in WGS84. A read-only query at the exact unchanged WUP point in Bordeaux commune code 33063 returned one full MultiPolygon with safe native cadastral key `idu` (33063000IX0001); only that ID and full geometry are retained.
scopeLimits: 110 valid distinct cadastral-reference polygons verified in thirteen bounded 0.001-degree cells around the unchanged WUP settlement locator. Complete counted paging, forced three-row geometry pages, all 110 fresh exact native identities, explicit absence, footprint and source binding passed in 41 requests. Independent metric EPSG:32630 GEOS found all polygons valid and distinct, with no sampled overlaps above 0.01 m² or operation errors. The existing national IGN/DGFiP Parcellaire Express provider and FR-PCI native idu namespace are reused. Native parcel33063000IX0001 covers the original exact WUP point and matches fresh complete geometry exactly. This is bounded settlement-local evidence, not proof of municipal cadastral completeness. Legal title, survey accuracy, currentness, long-term key continuity and wider municipal completeness remain unverified.
remainingUncertainty: Legal title, survey accuracy, currentness, long-term identity continuity and citywide completeness remain unverified.
nextStep: Parent review: verify source feature identity/geometry and decide runtime adapter qualification; keep exact-point coverage separate from citywide coverage.
